agendaItems.title: File No. DEO25-19315Resolution approving a Development Agreement by and between the City of Tampa and CB Capital Resources INC., d/b/a TRU Construction; providing for the conveyance of a City Infill lot located at 1526 N. Nebraska Avenue, Tampa, Florida 33602, and the development, construction, and sale/ rental of such property for use as an affordable single-family attached or single-family detached residential dwelling unit(s) by an income-qualified buyer or renter as part of the City’s Infill III Program; authorizing the Mayor to execute and the City Clerk to attest said agreement and exhibits thereto; providing an effective date. Memorandum from Chair Clendenin, requesting that said agenda item be pulled for discussion. (To be R/F)
